negative_reviews.author: Tegan Young
negative_reviews.text:
Me and my boyfriend went to Maki and Ramen for an early dinner as we wanted to try out the new restaurant in West Quay. There was a small queue (about 5 groups) when we got there with just one person greeting and taking people to their tables. There was also a member of staff dressing the tables near the welcoming area who had noticed the queue but did not come to seat or call someone to seat the queue. Eventually another member of staff came over to seat us. The restaurant was lovely and tidy and the food was incredible. We cannot fault the food at all: we both got the chicken ramen as there was a lot of the options out of stock ar 5pm on Saturday). The lady who served us said her name was Tinky (on the reciept it says we were served by Chuwei X). We were told about the options being out of stock before we could look at the menu, which was appreciated as we then were able to chose another option and not have the disappointment. When we ordered, Tinky did not seem very interested in me and my partner as we did not want any sides/extra drinks/deserts. We ordered a main and a drink and our bill came to nearly £40! After we had asked for the bill, it took about 10mins just for Tinky to get the card reader when we had seen other tables immediately able to pay.

TLDR: food was lovely but if you are just going for a main and a drink, youre better off going elsewhere!
